experience.title: Embedded Firmware Intern
bullets: Cut startup current spikes by 35% across 50 starts, measured with a current probe, by adding a 200 ms soft-start ramp to the STM32 PWM firmware that runs a 24 V brushless motor drive
Cut bring-up from 2 days to 4 hours with a Python script that tests 40 channels over UART
Cut dropped CAN bus messages from 1 in 200 to none over a 12-hour soak test by measuring the bit timing on an oscilloscope and moving the controller's sample point to 87.5%

experience.title: Test Engineering Intern
bullets: Cut each efficiency test on the 500 W power supply from 3 hours by hand to 25 minutes by automating a 20-point load sweep in LabVIEW, driving a programmable load and reading a power analyzer
Found a 15-degree hot spot that the derating curve missed on a 12 V module by logging 8 thermocouples through a 48-hour full-load test, which led to a larger heatsink on the next revision

projects.title: Senior Design: Solar Charge Controller
bullets: Harvested 18% more energy than a fixed-voltage controller on a solar array simulator by writing perturb-and-observe MPPT firmware in C for an STM32 that updates every 10 ms
Kept a 100 W buck stage under 70 degrees C at full load by laying it out on a 2-layer KiCad board
Held output ripple to 42 mV, measured on the oscilloscope, by sizing the output filter in LTspice

projects.title: Digital Audio Filter on an FPGA
bullets: Matched the MATLAB design within 0.3 dB in Vivado simulation with a 32-tap FIR low-pass filter in Verilog, using 16-bit fixed-point coefficients, on a Basys 3 FPGA board running at 48 kHz
